conviction_note: Q3 was pre-released on 2026-10-02 (rev $410-412m, adj EPS $0.55-0.59, FY cut) and the stock fell 21% that day, so the quarter is not the event. What is new on 10-21 is the Q4/2027 framing: a refinancing that lifts the effective rate near the top of a 100-200bp range (roughly $0.30/share of 2027 pre-tax interest against a $2.61 pre-cut 2027 consensus) against SurgiMend/Braintree relaunch milestones, insurance quantification and a stock at ~5.7x guided EPS with ~9% of shares short. The findings sum to +0.4 (cheapness and milestone upside narrowly outweigh the interest drag). p_up is 48, giving -0.4, because the name has sold 5 of its last 8 prints, including a -16.6% on a July beat with a reaffirmed guide. The two numbers differ in sign only at the margin, and both say the direction is close to a coin flip on a name that still moves a lot.
bar: The company's own preliminary Q3 figures (8-K, 2026-10-02): revenue ~$410-412m, adj EPS $0.55-0.59, OCF >$85m, FY26 revised to revenue $1.634-1.654bn and adj EPS $2.30-2.40 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000067/ex991_q3pressreleasepreann.htm). The pre-cut street Q3 was EPS $0.56 and revenue $416-417m (Benzinga/Earnings Whispers via search, two sources agreeing on EPS). Implied Q4 from the company's own numbers (Q1 $391.9m/$0.54, Q2 $418.8m/$0.56): revenue ~$411-433m against Q4'25 $434.9m, and adj EPS ~$0.61-0.75 against Q4'25 $0.83. 2027 consensus EPS $2.61 and revenue $1.73bn as of 2026-09-10, pre-cut (TIKR, one source).
positioning_check: FINRA short interest 7.3M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement (6.8M on 09-15, 6.5M on 07-31), about 9.3% of shares outstanding, 7.5 days to cover, borrow fee ~0.4% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/iart/short-interest/, read 2026-10-20). The short was building into the 10-02 cut, and no post-cut settlement was found. The baseline has no skew: the option chain is unusable (ATM spread 174% of mid, total OI 127, put/call OI 1.54, ATM IV ~100%). Tape: -16.4% over 20d, -3.3% over 5d, -32.5% from the 52w high, spot $13.39 against ~$12.68 at the 10-02 close (~+5.6% since). Moderately crowded short: it shrinks the negatives but is not a squeeze setup at 9%.

findings.finding: Q3 is already pre-released by the company: revenue ~$410-412m (incl. ~$7m flood hit, so ~$417-419m ex-flood vs the $410-425m guide midpoint $417.5m), adj EPS $0.55-0.59 (midpoint $0.57 vs pre-cut consensus $0.56), Q3 operating cash flow >$85m vs first-half OCF of only $32.6m. Preliminary unaudited ranges set on day 2 after quarter end usually print at or above the midpoint, so the final quarter is a small positive surprise at most.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name sells reported-quarter beats: Q2 2026 (2026-07-29) beat EPS $0.56 vs ~$0.48 with the guide reaffirmed and the stock fell 16.55%. Q3 2025 beat EPS $0.54 vs $0.43, missed revenue and fell 23.5%. Q1 2026 beat ($0.54 vs $0.40) with a raised guide and a CEO change, +24.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the ranges have been public since 10-02 and the stock reset 21% on them. Only the placement inside the range is new. If the market expected a print below the ranges, the stock would have kept falling after 10-02 instead of recovering ~5%.
findings.independence: Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000055/ex991-q22026earningsrelease.htm) gives the Q3 guide and H1 OCF used for comparison; same company, different document.

findings.finding: Refinancing closed 2026-10-19: $450m 9.500% senior secured notes due 2033 plus an amended ~$1.65bn secured facility ($600m revolver, $600m TLA 5y, $450m TLB 7y). The company says its effective interest rate rises 'near the high end of the anticipated 100-200 basis points range'. On ~$1.6-1.7bn of debt (net debt $1,600.7m at 6/30), 200bp is ~$32-34m a year pre-tax, ~$0.30-0.33 per share after tax. That is ~12% of the 2027 consensus EPS of $2.61 (pre-cut, 09-10), which also still has to absorb flood losses into Q2 2027. The money buys maturity extension and repayment of the old facility, not growth. A 9.5% secured coupon at 4.1x net leverage (4.8x total debt/compliance-adjusted EBITDA) is high-yield pricing. Offsetting: it removes refinancing risk and lengthens maturities, which the September deck named as a priority.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of an interest-driven guide on this name. Guidance lines have moved it hard: Q3 2025 Q4 guide below street -23.5%, 10-02 FY cut -21.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The rate guidance was in an 8-K Item 7.01 body, not the wire release, and the facility terms came in a 10-19 8-K the day before the print. The stock is flat since 10-09 ($13.41 then, $13.39 now), so either it was already priced or it has not been translated into 2027 numbers. No post-10-09 2027 consensus could be sourced. If 2027 estimates had come down ~$0.30, a target-cut cluster would be visible, and none was found. It reaches the stock only if management frames 2027 or the Q4 interest line on the call; Integra normally guides the next year in February.
findings.independence: Closing 8-K with facility terms (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/917520/000119312526425271/d142199dex991.htm), the same company and transaction, so it counts once. Interest of $66m in 2025 and $73m LTM is from the September 2026 investor deck (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/917520/000091752026000061/integrainvestorpresentat.htm). 2027 consensus $2.61 from TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/fr/blog/integra-lifesciences-sinks-11-as-july-flooding-event-forces-guidance-cut-and-600-million-loan).

findings.finding: Cincinnati flood (July 2026, MAYFIELD/specialty surgical site): ~$7m Q3 and $15-20m Q4 revenue lost, full manufacturing back in Q2 2027. Property and business-interruption insurance is expected to offset a 'substantial portion' of the earnings impact, but the claims were still being documented as of 10-02, so the call is the first chance to quantify recoveries and their timing. The implied Q4 adj EPS range is unusually wide for a quarter three weeks in ($0.61-0.75), so a narrowing or an insurance figure has room to land either side.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The flood line moved the stock twice: the 10-Q disclosure with Q2 (07-29, -16.55%) and the quantified cut (10-02, -21.2%).
findings.why_not_priced: No insurance dollar figure exists in any document. If the market had credited the recoveries, the stock would not sit at ~5.7x the cut EPS guide. Business-interruption recoveries are usually booked only when settled, so any figure given on the call is new.
findings.independence: The 10-Q for Q2 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000058/iart-20260630.htm) said the company did not then expect a material adverse effect after considering inventory and insurance. It is a different document, and it argues both ways: recoveries are expected, but the July assessment proved too optimistic.

findings.finding: Supply-restoration milestones fall due in Q4 2026 and will be confirmed or slipped on this call. The September 2026 investor deck says Braintree has been operational since end-June and is 'on track to generate commercial revenue in Q4 2026', SurgiMend relaunches in Q4 2026, and all warning-letter commitments are 'on track to be completed in 2026'. It also says products worth ~$150m of historical annual revenue return by end-2027 and transition costs fall >50% in 2026. A Q2 call summary said SurgiMend recovers ~50% of historical sales post-relaunch, with no significant 2026 contribution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Supply news has driven the large moves: Q3 2025 supply interruptions -23.5%. The PriMatrix/Durepair relaunch 12 months early was followed by Q1 2026 +24.1%, alongside a beat and the CEO change.
findings.why_not_priced: The 10-02 release talked of 'improving product availability, the return of key products to market', which hints the milestones held, but it gave no date or status for SurgiMend. A confirmed Q4 relaunch plus warning-letter close-out is a 2027 growth leg that a 5.7x multiple does not credit. A slip would add to a credibility hit the 10-02 cut already opened.
findings.independence: Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000055/ex991-q22026earningsrelease.htm): Braintree production started, SurgiMend relaunch 'on track for Q4 2026'. Same company, earlier document.

findings.finding: The 10-02 FY revenue cut ($30.5m at midpoints, $1,674.5m to $1,644m) is $3.5-8.5m larger than the flood's $22-27m, and the release cites updated assumptions beyond the flood. The 10-Q of 07-29 had said the flood was not expected to have a material adverse effect. That leaves a small non-flood softness and a credibility gap that the Q4 guide narrowing has to close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Credibility-led guide misses have been punished on this name: Q3 2025 -23.5% on a Q4 guide below street, 10-02 -21.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced by the -21% on 10-02. What is left is whether the non-flood gap is explained. Underlying Q3 ex-flood at ~$417-419m is in line with the old guide midpoint, which limits it.
findings.independence: Shares the 10-02 release with finding 1 for the cut figures (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000917520/000091752026000067/ex991_q3pressreleasepreann.htm). The July statement is from a different document.

findings.finding: The stock has de-rated to the cut. Spot $13.39 is ~5.7x the revised FY26 adj EPS midpoint ($2.35), -32.5% off its 52w high and -16.4% over 20 days. FINRA short interest was 7.3M shares (~9.3% of shares outstanding, 7.5 days to cover) at 09-30, building before the cut. So a pre-released print with no new negative can clear the shorts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 10-02 reset the stock drifted back ~5%. After the Q3 2025 reset (-23.5%) it was down only 1.1% a month later (nasdaq/Zacks).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by construction, since cheapness on a name already 30% off its high is not by itself a finding. Filed small. The mechanism is a clearing event on an already-reset name with ~7 days of short to cover; that would not exist if the short had covered after 10-02, and no post-10-02 settlement shows it did.
findings.independence: Simply Wall St 10-09 close $13.41, -28.6% over 90 days (https://www.webull.com/news/15716193516798976); baseline tape.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (unusable chain). The 20-day run-up is -16.4%, so the free control leans long. My findings lean marginally long while the name's reaction history leans down, so the evidence neither confirms the tape nor cuts strongly against it.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6 (reported quarter inside guidance, name sells beats): Q3 pre-release finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 5 / definition ('cheap after a drawdown is not a finding'): positioning/de-rating finding cut from +1.0 to +0.5, kept because a sourced short-interest figure gives it a mechanism.
Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the credibility finding is largely priced by the 10-02 -21%, cut from -0.5 to -0.3.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the money buys. It refinances the existing facility and extends maturities, with no growth use; the 9.5% secured coupon raises 2027 interest by ~$0.30/share. Kept negative at -1.0, with maturity-risk relief netted in.
Lesson 8 / core understatement: abs_move_pct raised from 9 to 10 given this name's 18.9% median reaction, though the pre-released quarter keeps it well below the median.
Lesson 7: short interest was looked up before filing the negatives; at 9.3% and 7.5 DTC it is moderate, and the negatives were not shrunk further.
